turns.question: Which call topic had the highest objection rate in September 2026, and what was that rate?
turns.answer: The returns topic had the highest objection rate in September 2026, at 72.7% of labelled calls (2026-09-01 to 2026-09-30; the labels are model-derived). Late: call_transcripts.silver is ready only up to 2026-10-03T00:00Z, older than its 36 h deadline.
